Before receiving a host's mods, the launcher shows the exact list of .dll files and asks for your OK. The hosts you always trust can be removed here: Settings > Co-op > On my side.

In the lobby: the Options card shows \"Host's\" (their choices, read-only) and \"Mine\" (voice, others' images, markers, map), for this lobby only. On the right, \"Host's files\" follows the arrival of their mods, content and save; \"Accept this host's content\" avoids asking again for what is not code. The lobby chat is under the players.
If the host sends mods, a window opens before any download: the exact list of .dll files, with their path, size and whether they are new, changed or already identical.
A .dll file is a program: it can do anything on your PC. Only accept if you trust this host.

Refuse (the default choice): you play without the host's mods, some items may be missing or different; \"See the files\", in the lobby, lets you change your answer. If their DLL list changes, you are asked again. Other programs (.exe, .bat...) are refused outright.

Always trust this host: Steam host of a private lobby only. Their DLLs you already accepted arrive without a question; a new or changed DLL asks again. Never in a public lobby or by IP. Remove them in Settings > Co-op > On my side > Trusted hosts.
Content without code (CDs, images, settings): click ACCEPT ALL once. It's remembered: \"Accept the host's content\" (Settings > Co-op > On my side) turns on, next times it's automatic.
MSCLoader missing on your side and you accepted: the launcher installs its Coop version, kept apart. Your game starts from a copy where the mods are the host's.

When joining a game in progress, the same question comes first. Accepted: MSCLoader is installed if missing (MWCoop's version if you don't have the official one) and the game waits until they're received to start. Your own mods are not touched.
On my side: voice, \"Accept the host's content\", trusted hosts, seeing the others' imported images and markers, the map (tap or hold), my content sent.
Guest: did you accept the list of files? \"See the files\", in the lobby, opens it again. Does the host have MSCLoader on?
